name: Scholium Bridge
description: Shows or hides annotations created by zotero-scholium in every Zotero reader with an eye button in the reader toolbar; they are hidden until it is first used, and the choice is remembered. On Zotero 7 to 9 it also provides token-protected local HTTP endpoints through which a script can create highlight and text annotations and child notes; Zotero 10 provides an official write API. The endpoints accept data only; no code is executed.
author: zotero-scholium contributors
